sources.title: BAAI/bge-m3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: For embedding retrieval, you can employ the BGE-M3 model using the same approach as BGE. The only difference is that the BGE-M3 model no longer requires adding instructions to the queries. For hybrid retrieval, you can use Vespa and Milvus. 3. How to fine-tune bge-M3 model? You can follow the common in this example to fine-tune the dense embedding.
